$comment: Hand-maintained source of truth for status, successors, defaults, capabilities and pricing. scripts/generate.mjs layers live provider lists and OpenRouter metadata UNDER these values (overrides always win) and writes catalog.json. Cite sources per provider; bump verifiedOn and pricingAsOf when you re-verify. Prices are USD per 1M tokens. Dates are ISO. A model whose retiresOn/deprecatedOn has passed is promoted to retired/deprecated by the generator.

claude-fable-5-1.name: Claude Fable 5.1
claude-fable-5-1.notes: Most capable; for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work.

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.name: Claude Haiku 4.5
claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.notes: Listed as legacy on the models overview; the deprecations table shows Active with retirement not sooner than 2026-10-15, which has just passed.

aws-bedrock.label: AWS Bedrock
aws-bedrock.notes: Only the Claude 5.x ids published in Anthropic's Bedrock ID row are listed. Bedrock sets its own lifecycle dates and offers global.* / regional inference-profile prefixes; the live listModels() result is authoritative for what an account can invoke. Non-Anthropic Bedrock models (Amazon Nova etc.) are not verified here.

anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5.name: Claude Haiku 5.5 (Bedrock)
anthropic.claude-haiku-5-5.pricingNote: Anthropic first-party prices; Bedrock may differ.

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.notes: maxTools 128 is the API's own rejection threshold ("maximum 128"), observed in clawser #411, not a documented table value.

gpt-6-luna.name: GPT-6 Luna
gpt-6-luna.notes: Most efficient; the documented replacement for gpt-4o-mini / gpt-4.1.

o3-mini.name: o3-mini
o3-mini.notes: Not on the deprecations page as of 2026-10-20; successor is the nearest current small model (inference).

gpt-4.1-nano.name: GPT-4.1 nano
gpt-4.1-nano.notes: Not on the deprecations page as of 2026-10-20; the sibling 4.1 models were deprecated 2026-10-14.

gemini.label: Google Gemini
gemini.notes: Gemini's list endpoint returns ids as models/<id>; the catalog and mergeLiveModels use the bare id.

gemini-4-argon.name: Gemini 4 Argon
gemini-4-argon.pricingNote: Doubles on 2026-12-01 (input 4 / output 20 / cache 0.20). Not on the free tier. Output can reach 1,048,576 with long decode.

gemini-3.7-flash.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash
gemini-3.7-flash.notes: Already shut down; requests auto-route to the successor.

gemini-3.5-flash.name: Gemini 3.5 Flash
gemini-3.5-flash.notes: Already shut down; requests auto-route to the successor.

gemini-2.5-flash.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Access limited to accounts that already used 2.5 models.

gemini-2.5-flash-lite.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
gemini-2.5-flash-lite.notes: Access limited to accounts that already used 2.5 models.

gemini-2.5-pro.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro
gemini-2.5-pro.notes: Access limited to accounts that already used 2.5 models. Price not captured (tiered by prompt size).

xai.label: xAI (Grok)
xai.notes: Prices are the under-200k-prompt tier; at 200k or more the whole request bills at about 2x. maxTools 128 carried over from clawser's #411 table (unverified against xAI docs).

grok-3.name: Grok 3
grok-3.notes: Named in xAI's 2026-05-15 retirement list (replacement: grok-4.3 with no reasoning effort), per the 2026-09-03 registry pass.

grok-2-latest.name: Grok 2
grok-2-latest.notes: Absent from xAI's current models table (docs.x.ai, 2026-10-20). Retirement is inferred from absence, not an announcement; the live list settles it.

mistral.label: Mistral AI
sources: carried from packages/aimatey-utils model registry, first-party pass of 2026-09-03 (ids, context, prices)
mistral.notes: Mistral's overview page did not expose API ids or prices in this pass; ids, context and prices are from the 2026-09-03 first-party registry pass (pricingAsOf reflects that). The -latest aliases are not pinned here because their targets are not documented.

mistral-large-4.name: Mistral Large 4 (public preview)
mistral-large-4.notes: Public preview since October 2026, 1M context, introductory pricing; price not captured.

deepseek.label: DeepSeek
deepseek.notes: Prices are the peak-hours rate (the higher of DeepSeek's two tiers; off-peak is half). OpenRouter slugs such as deepseek/deepseek-chat do not map to DeepSeek's current ids, so OpenRouter pricing is not used.

deepseek-v4-flash.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash (retired name)
deepseek-v4-flash.notes: Still accepted; served by deepseek-flash and billed at the Flash price.

deepseek-chat.name: DeepSeek Chat
deepseek-chat.notes: Not listed on the 2026-10-20 pricing or updates pages; status is inferred, the live list settles it.

deepseek-reasoner.name: DeepSeek Reasoner
deepseek-reasoner.notes: Not listed on the 2026-10-20 pricing or updates pages; status is inferred, the live list settles it.

moonshot.label: Moonshot (Kimi)
moonshot.notes: Pricing tables did not render in the fetched page, so no prices are recorded (the missing-pricing check warns). OpenRouter prices are deliberately not used for this provider (its kimi-k3 rate looks inconsistent with first-party).

groq.label: Groq
groq.notes: maxTools 128 carried over from clawser's #411 table (unverified against Groq docs).

llama-3.3-70b-versatile.name: Llama 3.3 70B Versatile
llama-3.3-70b-versatile.notes: Deprecations page: shutdown 08/16/26 (past), yet the models page still listed it on 2026-10-20 (pricing 'Contact Sales'). Kept deprecated, not retired, until a live list confirms.

mixtral-8x7b-32768.name: Mixtral 8x7B
mixtral-8x7b-32768.notes: Long gone from Groq's model list; retirement date not recorded on the current docs.

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.notes: OpenRouter hosts hundreds of models; only recommended ones are curated here. Everything else comes from the live list (mergeLiveModels) and the generator's OpenRouter pass. maxTools 128 carried over from clawser's #411 table.

perplexity.label: Perplexity
perplexity.notes: Not verified against first-party docs in this pass; models come from the live list. Perplexity's chat models do not take tool definitions.

together.label: Together AI
together.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

fireworks.label: Fireworks AI
fireworks.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

cohere.label: Cohere
cohere.notes: Only the models used for recommendations are curated; others come from the live list. command-a-plus-05-2026 is the model Cohere's v2 tool-use docs use in their examples. Pricing is not published on the docs pages, so none is recorded.

ai21.label: AI21 Labs
ai21.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

anyscale.label: Anyscale
anyscale.notes: Not verified in this pass. clawser's old default (Llama-2-70b-chat-hf) is a 2023 model.

cerebras.label: Cerebras
cerebras.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

dashscope.label: Alibaba DashScope
dashscope.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

deepinfra.label: DeepInfra
deepinfra.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

github-models.label: GitHub Models
github-models.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a token).

huggingface.label: Hugging Face
huggingface.notes: Router model list (2026-10-23) shows Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B with tool support on ovhcloud and deepinfra, 262144 context. Only recommended models are curated; the rest come from the live list. Pricing varies by routed provider, so none is recorded.

inception.label: Inception
inception.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

nvidia.label: NVIDIA NIM
nvidia.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

omniroute.label: OmniRoute
omniroute.notes: Routing gateway; 'auto' is the gateway's own selector, not a catalog model.

sambanova.label: SambaNova
sambanova.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a key).

azure-openai.label: Azure OpenAI
azure-openai.notes: Models are per-deployment names chosen by the account; nothing to curate. maxTools carried over from clawser #411.

cloudflare.label: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare.notes: Not verified in this pass; models come from the live list (needs a token + account id).

ollama.label: Ollama (local)
ollama.notes: Models are whatever the user pulled; clawser lists them from /api/tags.

lmstudio.label: LM Studio (local)
lmstudio.notes: Models are whatever is loaded; listed from /models.

chrome-ai.label: Chrome AI (on-device)
chrome-ai.notes: Chrome's Prompt API reports about 6k for Gemini Nano; 4096 is the conservative figure clawser budgets against (#411).

litert-lm.label: LiteRT-LM (on-device, WebGPU)
litert-lm.notes: LiteRT's Gemma web build ships a 4k context (#411).
